breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions. The incomplete prompt specified both Dirichlet conditions (u(0,t)=1, u(1,t)=0) and periodic conditions. The agent correctly removed the contradictory periodic condition, aligning with the ground truth which only specifies the Dirichlet conditions.
